where: hir-def nameres.rs (DefMap, DefMapPair, crate_local_def_map) and blaze-item-hash reads.rs Rule::Names
what: The design for name reads as facts listed five kinds of read (a name, the traits in scope, a whole scope, a module's children, a handle) and called every other row of name resolution a handle. Reading DefMap's fields showed it is not one: it holds the prelude module, the extern prelude (in DefMapPair's untracked half), the #[macro_use] prelude and the root's flags (no_std, edition, registered tools), and crate_shadows_primitive_type is a bool over every scope of the crate. Recorded as handles, a changed `extern crate` or #![no_std] would have served stale answers. Also: the rows of ScopeInput and of a paged scope are private to their files and a struct's fields share one ingredient, so the asked signature name_read(db, read) could not tell `scope` from `children`.
cost: about a quarter of a small context spent finding it; a sixth variant and a ninth fact kind (0x1808 CRATE_NAMES) not in the plan
whys: the request for name_read listed 21 row names and asked which are handles, without their values
RULES names a row by its debug name and file only: what a row's value holds is in no table
Rule::Names covered every key by the identity, so nobody had to know what each row's value was
the old identity hashed results (what each path resolved to), so inputs were never enumerated
no test changes a crate-level name input (extern prelude, prelude, no_std) under stored steps
cause: a rule that covers reads wholesale hides what each read is of; the move to facts needs the per-row values, which were never written down
class: a key that lists reads by name without saying what value each read reveals
prevention: name_read is the one place that says what each row of name resolution reveals, and Names::Facts refuses a row it does not answer for (listed by the flush); the refinement test under random edits (list f) must include edits of `extern crate`, #![no_std], a #[macro_use] and a shadowed primitive
fix: NameRead::Crate with values::crate_names (written, uncompiled); exported_derives, fn_proc_macro_mapping and derive_helpers_in_scope are left out of it and not yet shown unread by body steps
